reason: Kra pao with a fried egg and khai jiao moo sap I already make without thinking, and the ingredients cost about the same as a 50-baht plate from the stall, so I don't need an app for them. If I ever get stuck, three free questions a day is plenty, and 99 baht a month is two plates of food.
objection: I do not want another monthly subscription. It keeps charging after I forget about it, and for two dishes I already know, the free cooking clips I watch before bed are enough.
would_change_my_mind: Paying once instead of every month, plus lots of dishes I can't already cook. Even then, the free 3 questions a day would probably be enough for me.
